scope: Joint requirements, NOT assigned achievable losses; fixedtrajectory externalbus budget only
coupled_criterion: P=Wbus/(2A*half_duration)>0 AND Wbus/Qh>eta_TE(P), after solving ALL thermal/electrical/material/controller states periodically.
gate_note: Absoluteportenergycanpassivelyreroute/sharebuses; it is not a universal processor denominator. Actual topology and losses must be integrated.
material_requirement: A conditioned nonlinear material model must predict actual cyclic terminalwork, dissipatedheat,leakage,traps,domainstate and reset on this T/V path. The published transient cannot be counted as recoverable fastC already includedinG.
thermal_feedback: qin=qphot+qreg+qwire+Pdiss_body; Cnode*Tnode_dot=sum(bank->nodeheat)+Joule_node+control/coreloss_node. Processor loss removes busenergy and appears at its physical heat node.
reset_requirement: Every FE,graphene,isolator,inductor/core,buffer,regenerator/controller/material internal state returns. Stored energy drawdown is excluded.
